method: Reviewed transcript seed. Source ranks remain visible; only rows with adjust_rank=true move the optional health-adjusted layer.
sources: Verified transcript seed; merged with hosted Sleeper and nflverse refreshes

players.name: DJ Moore
players.notes: A play initially looked like a high-ankle injury, but Joe Brady said Moore was good to go.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.notes: Ankle injury after 14 preseason carries. The episode treated it as a likely high-ankle concern; the team had not provided a firm long-term timeline. He previously handled 8 of 11 starter snaps with 11 carries and 3 catches.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.notes: Suffered a non-contact groin strain while running a route. The episode had no confirmed timetable. Before the injury, he played 10 of 11 starter snaps and handled all four backfield opportunities.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.notes: Did not play and was described as week-to-week with a hamstring issue; Jonathan Brooks handled the starter work.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.notes: Specialist testing confirmed a stable toe sprain, but Todd Bowles would not confirm Week 1 availability.

players.name: George Kittle
players.notes: The team was very confident he would avoid PUP and said he had a chance to play Week 1. The risk of a guaranteed four-game absence declined.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.notes: New Orleans was still gathering medical opinions. The show used missed early-season games as the working assumption and said surgery remained within the possible range.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.notes: Returned to practice but described a planned snap count that may extend through roughly half the season.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.notes: Missed a full week with unspecified tightness. The hosts raised concern but had no confirmed diagnosis.

players.name: Jonathan Brooks
players.notes: Handled 8 of 10 starter snaps and all four backfield opportunities. This is encouraging usage evidence, not a confirmed new injury downgrade.
